{{ElectionsOH}}
The '''2010 Ohio State Treasurer election''' was held on November 2, 2010, to elect the [[Ohio State Treasurer]], concurrently with elections to the [[2010 United States Senate election in Ohio|United States Senate]], [[2010 United States House of Representatives elections in Ohio|U.S. House of Representatives]], [[2010 Ohio gubernatorial election|governor]], and other [[2010 Ohio elections|state]] and [[2010 United States elections#Local elections|local]] elections. Primary elections were held on May 4, 2010.<ref>{{Cite web |title=2010 Elections Results |url=https://www.ohiosos.gov/elections/election-results-and-data/2010-elections-results/ |access-date=November 3, 2025 |website=Ohio Secretary of State}}</ref>

Incumbent [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] treasurer [[Richard Cordray]] resigned as state treasurer following his election as the [[Ohio Attorney General]] in a [[2008 Ohio Attorney General special election|2008 special election]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Majors |first=Stephen |date=January 7, 2009 |title=New Ohio attorney general, treasurer take office |url=https://www.cantonrep.com/story/news/state/2009/01/08/new-ohio-attorney-general-treasurer/42552351007/ |access-date=November 3, 2025 |website=The Canton Repository}}</ref> Governor [[Ted Strickland]] appointed [[Columbus City Council]] member [[Kevin Boyce]] to serve as state treasurer.<ref name="guillen1" />

[[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] state representative [[Josh Mandel]] defeated Boyce in the general election.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=November 3, 2010 |title=Josh Mandel claims Ohio treasurer for GOP |url=https://www.toledoblade.com/local/politics/2010/11/02/Josh-Mandel-claims-Ohio-treasurer-for-GOP/stories/201011020018 |access-date=November 3, 2025 |website=The Toledo Blade}}</ref> Mandel led in fundraising throughout much of the campaign.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |last=Marshall |first=Aaron |date=January 29, 2010 |title=Mandel raising big bucks in state treasurer's race |url=https://www.cleveland.com/open/2010/01/mandel_raising_big_bucks_in_st.html |access-date=November 3, 2025 |website=The Plain Dealer}}</ref>
